scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/shared run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/shared run test && npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix packages/shared run test && npx --prefix backend vitest run tests/unit/ && npm --prefix frontend run test
